about_the_game:
If you appreciate my work and want to support me, this is the best way to do so. You'll get my gratitude and some cool perks!

Included in Supporter Edition

  • Upload any GIF as a custom skin for your player

  • Upload any image or GIF as a kill banner

  • Apply a custom gradient to your name

  • Get a VIP tag for your username

  • Access to the Selfie Stick joke item (take pictures of yourself and your friends!)

  • Use custom Redmatch 2 emoji in chat (:sad_bean:, :beg:, :empty_inside:, :cool_bean:, :flushed:, :heart_eyes:)

  • Get the Gold skin

  • Get the Sakura player trail

How to Access your Perks

  • You can access your custom skins and banners in the Customization menu under their respective tabs. Click the "Create" button to upload!

  • Change your name gradient or toggle your VIP tag in the Supporter Edition menu

  • Equip the Selfie Stick to a loadout in the loadout menu. Left clicking in-game takes a picture and saves it to your Steam screenshots.

  • Use Redmatch 2 emoji in chat by typing their name surrounded by colons, such as :beg:

  • Access your Gold skin and Sakura trail in the Customization menu under their respective tabs

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: 2.6 GHz Dual Core or similar
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 500 series or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
